d.s: Sika Cleaner-350H is a unique waterless hand-cleaning system combining both a high quality liquid hand cleaner formula and heavyduty, non-scratching, abrasive hand-cleaning towel.
a: Dissolves and absorbs dirt, grease and other soil
us: Apart from normal dirt and soil, Sika Cleaner-350H will remove heavy-grease, lubricants, adhesives, oils, tar, inks, wax and many other difficult to remove soil such as coal dust, graphite and grass stains etc.
